mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gemdori_purchase_history_table ( purchase_code, user_code, game_code, recipient_code, purchase_date, price, discount_rate, payment_method, purchase_status ) VALUES ( #{purchaseCode}, #{userCode}, #{gameCode}, #{recipientCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, -- NULL 가능성 명시 #{purchaseDate}, -- TO_DATE(#{purchaseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') 형식으로 변환 필요 시 #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{paymentMethod}, #{purchaseStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT 'P' || LPAD(PURCHASE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 7, '0') FROM DUAL -- 시퀀스 이름 'SEQ_PURCHASE_CODE'는 실제 DB 시퀀스 이름으로 변경

SELECT p.purchase_code, p.user_code, p.game_code, p.purchase_date, p.price, p.discount_rate, p.payment_method, p.purchase_status, g.game_title, g.game_main_image FROM gemdori_purchase_history_table p JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON p.game_code = g.game_code WHERE p.user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY p.purchase_date DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.purchase_code, p.user_code, p.game_code, p.purchase_date, p.price, p.discount_rate, p.payment_method, p.purchase_status, g.game_title, g.game_main_image FROM gemdori_purchase_history_table p JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON p.game_code = g.game_code WHERE p.user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY p.purchase_date DESC
